A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TINED and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Retained content can be matched despite retitling, renumbering and appendix reordering.

before.justification: V1 reports original node-classification experiments, inference-time measurements, ablations and approximation-error analyses across seven datasets.

after.justification: V2 retains those experiments and reports additional baseline comparisons, heterophilic benchmarks, sensitivity analyses and embedding visualizations.

M1.justification: Teacher injection, gradient-controlled fine-tuning, paired FC layers, the DED objective and adaptations to other GNN teachers are unchanged. Edge sampling and DE-ratio transformations already appear in v1 Appendix A.4; their subsequent evaluation does not introduce new method components.

E1.justification: V2 adds Squirrel and Amazon-ratings evaluations under the production setting (Table 6), extending coverage to explicitly heterophilic Wikipedia and product co-purchasing graphs. All seven original datasets remain.

E2.justification: KRD and FFG2M join Tables 1–2 and Figures 3–4; VQGraph is newly evaluated in Appendix A.9. Tables 8–9 introduce a four-layer vanilla MLP comparator. The standalone MLP comparison disappears from Figure 4 but remains elsewhere.

E3.justification: Added evaluation designs include two-versus-four-layer MLP controls, eta/beta/zeta sweeps, embedding comparisons at epochs 0 and 500, and separately trained and tuned VQGraph teachers. The original dataset splits, production partition, accuracy metric and validation-based model selection remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V2 adds fine-tuning and DED-weight sensitivity tests, sampling-ratio analysis, MLP-depth controls and initialization/convergence t-SNE analyses (Tables 5, 7–9, 12; Figures 5 and 9). These substantially extend the retained component ablations, approximation-error analysis and DE-ratio studies.

E5.justification: Both versions specify ten trials with distinct random seeds and report means and standard deviations; Figure 1 also averages ten repetitions. Added result tables follow the existing reporting practice, without new confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Shared entries in Tables 1–2, ablations, approximation errors and retained Figure 4 bars are unchanged. Numerous results are added, including KRD exceeding TINED on Pubmed production accuracy (76.00 versus 75.79) and TINED achieving 41.95 on Squirrel production. New MLP-control tables report different two-layer MLP scores from the main tables without explaining the discrepancy.

T1.justification: Theorem 4.1, its assumptions and pseudoinverse proof, the Dirichlet-energy definitions and other-teacher derivations are retained. The proof moves from Appendix A.3 to A.2, with equation renumbering but no substantive mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: layer-wise distillation through teacher injection and DED, a GP approximation bound, and effective, fast MLP inference. They still summarize experiments as covering seven datasets despite v2's additional coverage.

C2.justification: V2 adds interpretations linking embedding similarity to knowledge transfer, deeper vanilla-MLP degradation to overfitting, and sensitivity results to tuning and sampling tradeoffs. It removes the description of the bound as demonstrating tightness and adds heterogeneous/dynamic graphs as future directions; the student-depth limitation remains.

D1.justification: The code-access statement changes from supplementary material to an explicit repository link. Appendix A.9 supplies VQGraph teacher and student hyperparameter search spaces. Existing TINED implementation details, hardware, training-time information and search spaces are retained after relocation.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds explicit layer-wise distillation precedents, FreeKD, MLPInit and broader GNN application references, while removing some generic cross-domain references. V2 also distinguishes VQGraph's teacher retraining from fixed-teacher distillation. The central research positioning remains.

P1.justification: V2 revises the title and abstract, edits selected related-work and results passages, shortens the Teacher Injection heading, and reorders appendix subsections. Acknowledgements and an impact statement are added. The main section sequence and most method exposition remain intact.

P2.justification: Tables 1–2 gain comparator columns, seven additional tables and two t-SNE figures are introduced, and existing displays are relocated or resized. Figure 4 is redrawn with additional baselines, a revised legend, removal of the standalone MLP bar and a narrower accuracy axis.

improvement.justification: V2 substantially strengthens empirical validation by addressing important gaps in comparator coverage and testing heterophilic applicability, parameter sensitivity and model-depth alternatives. These additions make the retained method and results more thoroughly assessable. Unexplained MLP-score discrepancies and missing heterophilic split details limit reproducibility of some additions, but do not outweigh the broader comparative and diagnostic evidence.
